# Reporting (server)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

The readiness assessment and the board report.

## Files

- `assessment-routes.ts`: The readiness assessment: scores per area, with suggestions from the records.
- `assessment-scores.ts`: Suggests readiness assessment scores from the engagement's own records.
- `report-routes.ts`: The board report: build it from the records and sign it off.

## Routes

Full detail, with request fields, in [`docs/API.md`](../../../../docs/API.md).

| Method | Path | Permission | Body |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/engagements/:id/assessment` | read |  |
| PUT | `/api/engagements/:id/assessment/:area` | manage_engagement | `(inline schema)` |
| GET | `/api/engagements/:id/report` | read |  |
| POST | `/api/engagements/:id/report/sign` | sign_off_report |  |
